english.note: Use this when you specifically mean the Western immortal bird reborn from its ashes rather than the Chinese fenghuang.

examples.english: In Western legend, the phoenix is reborn after burning to ashes.
examples.traditional: 西方傳說入面，不死鳥燒成灰之後會重生。
